name: Captain Hook's Honey-BBQ Slow-Baked Baby Back Pork Ribs (Pirate Night)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · Pirate Night Menu
whyItWorks: Oven-braised until fall-off-the-bone tender, but high pork rib fat, sticky BBQ glaze, and accompanying corn on the cob/coleslaw require caution.
prepOrOrderInstructions: In remission, eat the leanest rib meat with mashed potatoes instead of the corn cob and raw coleslaw.
watchOuts: High rendered pork fat and sugary tomato-garlic BBQ glaze
Skip corn on the cob and coleslaw sides
